slice: MAP-3 residual — I_map1Smoke Places smoke miss
classification: HARNESS FLAKE — not an app defect

rootCause.summary: map1_smoke missed Places because the a11y-driven harness could not reach the 'Confirm pickup' proposal card or the destination EditText — both were visually rendered but sat below the uiautomator viewport clip — and the typed query used a wrong input-text escape.
details: Single-shot dumps raced Places reverse-geocode: 'Use current location' resolved 'Izmir Extension, Lahore' via Places searchNearby, but the 'Confirm pickup' proposal card was below the uiautomator-reported viewport at every fixed-sleep dump (visually rendered, absent from a11y tree) → confirm never tapped → strip stayed 'Pickup set · destination needed' (ride_map_preview_model.dart hasPickup branch).

With the proposal card open, the destination EditText never appeared in the dump → `len(edits) >= 2` was false → no tap → `input text` dropped with no focused editable → 'Liberty' absent from all dumps → placesSuggestions=false.

`input text 'Liberty%20Market'` used %20; Android Input.java only unescapes %s→space, so the literal string 'Liberty%20Market' would be sent to Places even when typed (map1_physical.py already used %s).
`reviewReached` additionally required 'Google Map'/'Map preview' a11y labels which the REVIEW pane does not emit (compose pane only) — even a fully reached review would still miss on that predicate.

Run6 screenshot (map2a_map1_smoke_review.png @11:01) shows the proposal card rendered + pickup resolved — same APK, same Places key/endpoints as the working searchNearby reverse-geocode → app-side Places pipeline functional.
rootCause.placesApiFunctional: YES — pickup proposal 'Izmir Extension, Lahore' is a Places v1:searchNearby result (same ORA_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY + host as autocomplete); autocomplete then returned 'Liberty Market Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan' and place resolve + confirm worked on-device.

fix.scope: map1_smoke() + 3 module helpers (_tap_desc_contains, _edit_nodes, _screen_size, _scroll_sheet) — harness only; no product code
changes: Poll 'Confirm pickup'/'Confirm destination' proposal cards (12×/8× ~1.5s) instead of single-shot sleep(4); scroll the compose sheet when the card is below the a11y fold.
Destination field selected as last EditText, or the lone EMPTY EditText when pickup already holds the resolved label (post-scroll only one field stays in the tree).
Typed query 'Liberty%sMarket' — correct input-text space escape.
Suggestion detection = clickable node whose desc starts with 'Liberty' (EditText desc is empty — typed text can no longer false-positive the check).
Continue polled until clickable (enabled only when both points confirmed).
reviewReached accepts review-pane markers 'Select a ride'/'Trip summary' in addition to 'Google Map'/'Map preview'.

rerun.command: cd mobile/.e2e_artifacts && python3 -c "import json; import map2a_physical as M; print(json.dumps(M.map1_smoke()))"
rerun.placesSuggestionTapped: Liberty Market Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan

reviewEvidence.fare: Estimated fare Rs 1140 (visible in screenshot; a11y 'Rs' text below dump fold at capture — offer EditText '1140' was dumped)

checkIEvaluation: I_map1Smoke = rideRequestOpened && reviewReached && pickupDestMarkers → PASS (all true). Combined with run6 core checks (Recenter/OD1/G-tick/H all PASS), MAP-3 physical gap is closed on this build.
verdictLabel: I_map1Smoke CLOSEOUT — PASS on SM-A325F (harness flake corrected; Places path verified end-to-end)
knownLimitations: OTP 'Verify' taps still MISS — debug build auto-verifies; unrelated to this gap.
A11y viewport clip remains a device quirk: harness now scrolls to expose below-fold nodes rather than assuming they dump.
pricingVisible key still string-matches 'Rs' which sits below the review fold in uiautomator; fare presence proven visually + by offer EditText '1140'.
Interim rerun2 failed at login (transient 'Network error' on OTP send) — environment flake, not app/harness logic; rerun3/4 passed login deterministically.
scopeDiscipline: No product Dart/backend/RTDB/provider changes; no deploy; no live ride submitted; previous MAP-3 reports untouched.
